children.name: Undistributed offsetting receipts
children.desc: Not an organisation. The Monthly Treasury Statement nets these receipts against total outlays without assigning them to any agency or branch, so this line sits beside the three branches: Other Interest (-$5.85M); Employer Share, Employee Retirement (-$134.39B); Interest Received by Trust Funds (-$215.94B); Rents and Royalties on the Outer Continental Shelf Lands (-$7.76B); Sale of Major Assets (-$1.44M). Total Outlays is the branches' figures plus this line, to the cent.
